mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS teaching_count, COALESCE(SUM(t.attendee_count), 0) AS attendee_count FROM (SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dtl_attendance a WHERE a.session_id = s.id AND a.deleted = FALSE AND a.attend_status = #{attendPresent}) AS attendee_count FROM biz_training_session s WHERE s.lecturer_id = l.id AND s.deleted = FALSE AND s.session_state IN #{st} ) t ) stats ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(f.score)::NUMERIC, 1) AS avg_score FROM dtl_training_feedback f JOIN biz_training_session s ON s.id = f.session_id AND s.deleted = FALSE WHERE s.lecturer_id = l.id AND f.deleted = FALSE ) rating ON TRUE
mapper.select:
SELECT l.*, stats.teaching_count, stats.attendee_count, rating.avg_score FROM biz_lecturer l
ORDER BY ${sortColumn} ${sortDirection} NULLS LAST, l.id DESC LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT l.*, stats.teaching_count, stats.attendee_count, rating.avg_score FROM biz_lecturer l
WHERE l.id = #{id} AND l.deleted = FALSE

SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.session_no, s.session_name, s.course_id, c.course_name, s.training_date AS teaching_date, s.session_state, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dtl_attendance a WHERE a.session_id = s.id AND a.deleted = FALSE AND a.attend_status = #{attendPresent}) AS attendee_count, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(f.score)::NUMERIC, 1) FROM dtl_training_feedback f WHERE f.session_id = s.id AND f.deleted = FALSE) AS avg_score, s.training_form, s.created_by, s.updated_at FROM biz_training_session s LEFT JOIN biz_course c ON c.id = s.course_id AND c.deleted = FALSE WHERE s.lecturer_id = #{lecturerId} AND s.deleted = FALSE AND s.session_state IN #{st} ORDER BY s.training_date DESC, s.id DESC

SELECT f.id, f.session_id, s.session_no, s.training_date, f.submitter_name, f.submitter_dept, f.score, f.content, f.feedback_scene, f.imported_at AS submitted_at FROM dtl_training_feedback f JOIN biz_training_session s ON s.id = f.session_id AND s.deleted = FALSE WHERE s.lecturer_id = #{lecturerId} AND f.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY f.imported_at DESC, f.id DESC
